Author: hiarc
Name: Ostinato
Description: Swaps the pressed action for the next step of your rotation, using per-job rules you can switch on and off.
TestingChangelog:
Test build for PR #18: M100: headless screenshots of the real UI

1. No visible changes. The plugin's drawing code now lives in its own library (Ostinato.Ui.dll ships alongside the plugin) so it can be rendered outside the game for testing. Every tab should look and behave exactly as before; please report anything that doesn't.

Minor: the on/off switch is now drawn by the plugin itself instead of Dalamud's helper, with the same look and click area.
